# Vendored Markdown runtime

Pinned packages: markdown-it-py 4.0.0, mdit-py-plugins 0.5.0, mdurl 0.1.2.

The package distributions and their license metadata are retained in this directory. Imports are restricted to the site build and preview runtime. No package installation is needed to build the site offline.

KaTeX is kept separately in assets/katex; VERSION.json records its version, source archive and checksum. Its license is included.
